Title: Application Insights supports collecting custom metrics and properties

Body.Content: Visual Studio Application Insights supports collecting custom metrics, events, and properties. This gives you a 360-degree view of your application with powerful insights into what users are doing with your application and how it is performing. To learn more, see Metrics Explorer - Custom metrics, events, and properties. Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
Body.Markdown:
Visual Studio Application Insights supports collecting custom metrics, events, and properties. This gives you a 360-degree view of your application with powerful insights into what users are doing with your application and how it is performing.

To learn more, see Metrics Explorer - Custom metrics, events, and properties .

Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
